After-Work Road Bike Ride and Refreshments

Littleton, CO · Road

After-Work Road Bike Ride and Refreshments is a road group ride in Littleton, CO. It rolls every Tuesday at 5:30 pm from Platte River Bar and Grill (lot behind).

The host says latecomers who have not messaged are usually not waited for. Bring lights as the days shorten.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15-18 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness.
Check
Check the links below the day of for cancellations and weather calls.

About the After-Work Road Bike Ride and Refreshments group ride

A Tuesday after-work road ride on the S. Platte River bike trail, usually out to the south side of Chatfield State Park. Expect 25 to 30 miles at 15 to 18 mph, all paved. The group grabs a beer and food after.
